body:
(Sorry for the close, mouse finger messed up ^^)

We can easily fix the problem with `HTMLElement` and similar Types (`Window`, `Document`) by adding them to the `BaseTypes`. That's correct as the properties of these types shouldn't be recursively walked by `Unwrap` anyways. I'll have a PR up for that in a second.

For the more general case about `Symbol.Iterator` that @jacekkarczmarczyk added, we should look at [this PR](https://github.com/vuejs/vue-next/pull/579) from @pikaxas well as this comment from discord:

> So I was bored and did some more digging. The issue is caused by this https://github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/issues/24622. It's possible to work around it for general types by doing something like this:

```typescript
type UnwrapTest<T> = {
  [P in keyof T]: T[P]
} & (T extends { [Symbol.iterator]: infer V } ? { [Symbol.iterator]: V } : {})
```

should be adaptable for our UnwrapRef implementation and seems to go in a similar direction as @pikax's PR.

issue.title: Property '[Symbol.toPrimitive]' is missing in type 'UnwrappedObject<Date>' but required in type 'Date'.

labels.name: kind/bug
labels.description: Some behavior is incorrect or out of spec

repository.name: pulumi
repository.description: Pulumi - Infrastructure as Code in any programming language 🚀

issue.body:
Because of know issue in TypeScript `keyof`: https://github.com/Microsoft/TypeScript/issues/24622 putting a js Date object into `pulumi.output` causes a compilation error: 
` Property '[Symbol.toPrimitive]' is missing in type 'UnwrappedObject<Date>' but required in type 'Date'.`
This issue has been fixed in the upcoming TS 4.3 release, however, this version is scheduled for May 2021 so IMO it's worth introducing a workaround for it.

## Expected behavior
No compilation errors.

## Current behavior
```index.ts:13:61 - error TS2345: Argument of type 'UnwrappedObject<Artefact>' is not assignable to parameter of type 'Artefact'.
  Types of property 'lastModified' are incompatible.
    Property '[Symbol.toPrimitive]' is missing in type 'UnwrappedObject<Date>' but required in type 'Date'.

13 pulumi.output(artefact).apply((a: Unwrap<Artefact>) => test(a))
                                                               ~

  ../../.npm/_npx/26528/lib/node_modules/typescript/lib/lib.es2015.symbol.wellknown.d.ts:114:5
    114     [Symbol.toPrimitive](hint: "default"): string;
            ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
    '[Symbol.toPrimitive]' is declared here.


Found 1 error.
```

## Steps to reproduce
1. Clone: https://github.com/dimitor115/pulumi-unwrapped-error-reproduction
2. Run `npm install`
3. Run `npx typescript@latest `

If you run `npx typescript@next` (the upcoming version) there will be no errors.

## Context (Environment)
- Node 15
- TypeScript 4.2.x
- Pulumi 2.23.x

## Affected feature
pulumi.Output<T>

## Potential fix

There are other projects that were facing this issue too:
- https://github.com/ryansolid/solid/issues/228
- https://github.com/vuejs/vue-next/issues/951

As I understand the implemented workarounds in the projects above, the following modification to the UnwrappedObject type will be enough. At least it is compiling with TypeScript 4.2.x now and I'm able to do the `pulumi up`.

```typescript
type AddSymbolToPrimitive<T> = T extends
    {[Symbol.toPrimitive]: infer V;} ?
    {[Symbol.toPrimitive]: V;} :
    {};

export declare type UnwrappedObject<T> = {
    [P in keyof T]: Unwrap<T[P]>;
} & AddSymbolToPrimitive<T>;
```
